key_idea: Tokenise the whole input on whitespace and validate strictly: exactly three tokens, digits only, no leading zeros, bounded length, then check even/range/sum/primality by trial division.
sketch: Read all of stdin, split on space/tab/newline/CR. Reject unless there are exactly 3 tokens, each consisting only of digits, with no leading zero and at most 10 characters (guards overflow from 100-digit tokens). Then require the first to be even, >3 and <=1e9, the other two to sum to it and both be prime (trial division up to sqrt, <=31623 steps). Pitfalls: signs like +7, empty input, huge digit strings, token '0', and the value 1 not being prime.
